entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. Yes, I... I bought a VeloBand GPS Tracker and I think I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your order, could I please get your full name and order number?
Yes, it's Alex Chen. Order number is... VF788912. It's just, I'm not really sure what I'm supposed to do.

Thank you, Alex. I have your account pulled up here. I see the VeloBand was delivered about 35 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it works perfectly fine. It's just... I changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and honestly, I just don't use it like I thought I would. I feel a bit silly. The website was a little overwhelming and I can't find the right page now. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. It's no problem at all. So just to be clear, the device is working correctly, you'd simply prefer to return it?
Yes, exactly. I'm sorry to be a bother.
Not a bother in the slightest, Alex. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. Please hold for one moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've just reviewed our policy, and it looks like you're well within the return window.
Really? Oh, I was so worried I had missed the deadline.

Not at all. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. Since you're only at day 35, we can definitely get this processed for you. I am generating a prepaid return label and sending it to the email we have on file right now.
Wow, that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Diana. I really appreciate you making that so easy.
You are very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the item, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
